Package it.polimi.ingsw.server

Interface Connection

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIClientReceiver, SocketConnection
public interface Connection extends Remote
This interface is the Connection interface of the server side of the application. It allows the server to send messages to the client based on the connection type (socket or RMI).
